next_action.if_nothing: Cash goes below zero in 8 days.
next_action.after: At its lowest point, in 8 days, cash would still be ¥300,000.00 below your minimum cash reserve; today it is ¥127,506.90 below.
next_action.why: No committed funding restores the reserve; this is the cheapest way to stay above zero.
next_action.detail: Projected cash closes at ¥172,493.10 today, ¥127,506.90 below your minimum cash reserve; the gap peaks at ¥327,506.90 in 8 days and lasts until 42 days from now. No funding plan restores your minimum cash reserve; the plan that keeps cash at or above zero is: finance an invoice on Invoice financing (onboarded platform) ¥27,506.90, cost ¥245.12 (32.5% a year for 10 days); that is above the 15.00% limit you signed for funding without your approval, so it needs your approval before it runs. It does not restore the reserve: cash stays at or above zero, but the reserve is still ¥300,000.00 short at the worst day, which needs the owner's decision. The projection lets cash run below zero only as a simulation limit; the bank does not allow an overdraft, so a negative figure is a day the books cannot pay what falls due.
